findings.title: Second LK tab keeps the join-request pop-up and Requests count after the request was approved in the other tab
findings.where: LK desk, laptop and tablet (also on control for the card); OperationsPanel / pending list
findings.steps: Open the LK desk in two tabs (the later tab owns the socket). A join request is pending. Approve in tab A (pop-up). Look at tab B.
findings.expected: Tab B drops the request card, pop-up and the count; the comment at OperationsPanel.jsx:88 says a request 'another tab answered' is handled.
findings.actual: Tab B still shows the NEW JOIN REQUEST pop-up (now with 'Already has an investigator here.') and 'Requests 1', although the roster in B lists the approved investigator and the log line arrived. A reload clears it. Same stale card on control.

findings.title: A closed request's note stays when a different player's request arrives
findings.steps: Open a request's sheet, the player withdraws (note appears), another player asks.
findings.expected: The decision text says a new request clears the note.
findings.actual: Only the same investigator asking again clears it; a different new request leaves the old sheet with 'no longer waiting' and Back to requests, while the new one is only a badge/pop-up.

findings.title: Accessible name 'About About Reset' is doubled
findings.steps: Open an investigator's sheet on the LK desk and read the button names.
findings.actual: The button is named 'About About Reset' (the label already starts with About).

findings.title: A superseded LK tab goes dead without a way back
findings.steps: Open the LK desk in a second tab; look at the first.
findings.expected: A way to take the desk back.
findings.actual: First tab shows the banner and all tension and timer buttons turn disabled; only a reload recovers. Known last-connection-wins design, noted because the new strip makes it more visible.

findings.expected: Small and out of the way.
findings.actual: Large card; Later closes it. On phone Reject wraps to a second row.

method: Folder /home/user/pt4/verify/lkdesk. lib.js is v8401_lib.js made tree-aware (TREE=main|control picks api 8130/8131, db candela_<api>, own state_<tree>.json and out_<tree>/ shots). setup.js builds, per tree, a sealed 4-investigator circle S (one agreed, one pending relationship via seal.js), an empty campaign E and an unsealed 3-member campaign F; extra devices (w1024, w1100, w1279, w1280, wide761, tabland) were added to lib.js. One script per check: nav.js, fit.js, req.js, wd.js, wd2.js, strip2.js, stamp.js, rep.js, end.js, add.js, form.js, form2.js, sheet.js, s57.js, two.js, two2.js, ten3.js, rst.js, disp.js, pc.js. Pitfalls: node scripts holding an open Node WebSocket never exit (use process.exit or timeout; do not pkill -f); a second LK tab on the same account takes the socket and disables the first, so use one seat per account for strip checks; check() on a checkbox can fail because the tick is server driven (use click and wait); text read after pressing Add Illumination no longer has the Not filed line, so read it before. A player can wait in only one campaign. Control phone has no MENU button. Not checked: 45.4 at 1920x1080 (1440x761, 1366x768, 1280x720 done), a refused session while the desk is already open (#57 tried only on load), the phone Requests count after a reload on its own.
praise: The Requests tab with its count and the live-region announcement make join requests easy to find and survive a reload.
The sticky stamp row at xl keeps Dispatch, End Assignment and the 'Dispatched at' receipt in view at 1440x761, 1366x768 and 1280x720, and the armed End hint opens upward.
The table strip's tension and Start/Pause/Resume buttons work on Circle, Notebook and sheet views, with 44px targets on touch and read-only on the phone.
Confirms are one sentence with a one-verb button everywhere checked; the Not filed line works without blocking.
A server restart with the desk open reconnects cleanly and the strip keeps working.
